verses.zh: 弟兄们，论到属灵的恩赐，我不愿意你们不明白。
verses.en: With regard to spiritual gifts,[NOTE:1] brothers and sisters,[NOTE:2] I do not want you to be uninformed.[NOTE:3]
notes: Grk “brothers.” See note on the phrase “brothers and sisters” in 1:10.

verses.zh: 你们作外邦人的时候，随事被牵引，受迷惑，去服事那哑巴偶像，这是你们知道的。
verses.en: You know that when you were pagans you were often led astray by speechless idols, however you were led.

verses.zh: 所以我告诉你们，被　神的灵感动的，没有说「耶稣是可咒诅」的；若不是被圣灵感动的，也没有能说「耶稣是主」的。
verses.en: So I want you to understand that no one speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus is cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.

verses.zh: 恩赐原有分别，圣灵却是一位。
verses.en: Now there are different gifts, but the same Spirit.

verses.zh: 职事也有分别，主却是一位。
verses.en: And there are different ministries, but the same Lord.

verses.zh: 功用也有分别，　神却是一位，在众人里面运行一切的事。
verses.en: And there are different results, but the same God who produces all of them in everyone.

verses.zh: 圣灵显在各人身上，是叫人得益处。
verses.en: To each person the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the benefit of all.

verses.zh: 这人蒙圣灵赐他智慧的言语，那人也蒙这位圣灵赐他知识的言语，
verses.en: For one person is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, and another the message of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

verses.zh: 又有一人蒙这位圣灵赐他信心，还有一人蒙这位圣灵赐他医病的恩赐，
verses.en: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healing by the one Spirit,

verses.zh: 又叫一人能行异能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨别诸灵，又叫一人能说方言，又叫一人能翻方言。
verses.en: to another performance of miracles, to another prophecy, and to another discernment of spirits, to another different kinds of tongues, and to another the interpretation of tongues.

verses.zh: 这一切都是这位圣灵所运行、随己意分给各人的。
verses.en: It is one and the same Spirit, distributing as he decides to each person, who produces all these things.

verses.zh: 就如身子是一个，却有许多肢体；而且肢体虽多，仍是一个身子；基督也是这样。
verses.en: For just as the body is one and yet has many members, and all the members of the body—though many—are one body, so too is Christ.

verses.zh: 我们不拘是犹太人，是希腊人，是为奴的，是自主的，都从一位圣灵受洗，成了一个身体，饮于一位圣灵。
verses.en: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body. Whether Jews or Greeks or slaves[NOTE:1] or free, we were all made to drink of the one Spirit.
notes: See the note on the word “slave” in 7:21.

verses.zh: 身子原不是一个肢体，乃是许多肢体。
verses.en: For in fact the body is not a single member, but many.

verses.zh: 设若脚说：「我不是手，所以不属乎身子，」它不能因此就不属乎身子。
verses.en: If the foot says, “Since I am not a hand, I am not part of the body,” it does not lose its membership in the body because of that.

verses.zh: 设若耳说：「我不是眼，所以不属乎身子，」它不能因此就不属乎身子。
verses.en: And if the ear says, “Since I am not an eye, I am not part of the body,” it does not lose its membership in the body because of that.

verses.zh: 若全身是眼，从哪里听声呢？若全身是耳，从哪里闻味呢？
verses.en: If the whole body were an eye, what part would do the hearing? If the whole were an ear, what part would exercise the sense of smell?

verses.zh: 但如今，　神随自己的意思把肢体俱各安排在身上了。
verses.en: But as a matter of fact, God has placed each of the members in the body just as he decided.

verses.zh: 若都是一个肢体，身子在哪里呢？
verses.en: If they were all the same member, where would the body be?

verses.zh: 但如今肢体是多的，身子却是一个。
verses.en: So now there are many members, but one body.

verses.zh: 眼不能对手说：「我用不着你。」头也不能对脚说：「我用不着你。」
verses.en: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you,” nor in turn can the head say to the foot, “I do not need you.”

verses.zh: 不但如此，身上肢体人以为软弱的，更是不可少的。
verses.en: On the contrary, those members that seem to be weaker are essential,

verses.zh: 身上肢体，我们看为不体面的，越发给它加上体面；不俊美的，越发得着俊美。
verses.en: and those members we consider less honorable we clothe with greater honor, and our unpresentable members are clothed with dignity,[NOTE:1]

verses.zh: 我们俊美的肢体，自然用不着装饰；但　神配搭这身子，把加倍的体面给那有缺欠的肢体，
verses.en: but our presentable members do not need this. Instead, God has blended together the body, giving greater honor to the lesser member,

verses.zh: 免得身上分门别类，总要肢体彼此相顾。
verses.en: so that there may be no division in the body, but the members may have mutual concern for one another.

verses.zh: 若一个肢体受苦，所有的肢体就一同受苦；若一个肢体得荣耀，所有的肢体就一同快乐。
verses.en: If one member suffers, everyone suffers with it. If a[NOTE:1] member is honored, all rejoice with it.
notes: ‡ Before μέλος (melos, “member”) the great majority of witnesses read ἕν (hen, “one”; א2 C D F G Ψ 0285 33 1881 M latt sy), while the most significant of the Alexandrian mss omit it (P46 א* A B 1739). The addition of ἕν appears to be motivated by its presence earlier in the verse with μέλος and the parallel structure of the two conditional clauses in this verse, while little reason can be given for its absence (although accidental oversight is of course possible, it is not likely that all these witnesses should have overlooked it). NA28 has the word in brackets, indicating doubt as to its authenticity.

verses.zh: 你们就是基督的身子，并且各自作肢体。
verses.en: Now you are Christ’s body, and each of you is a member of it.

verses.zh: 神在教会所设立的：第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教师，其次是行异能的，再次是得恩赐医病的，帮助人的，治理事的，说方言的。
verses.en: And God has placed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, gifts of healing, helps, gifts of leadership, different kinds of tongues.

verses.zh: 岂都是使徒吗？岂都是先知吗？岂都是教师吗？岂都是行异能的吗？
verses.en: Not all are apostles, are they? Not all are prophets, are they? Not all are teachers, are they? Not all perform miracles, do they?

verses.zh: 岂都是得恩赐医病的吗？岂都是说方言的吗？岂都是翻方言的吗？
verses.en: Not all have gifts of healing, do they? Not all speak in tongues, do they? Not all interpret, do they?[NOTE:1]
notes: The questions in vv. 29-30 all expect a negative response.

verses.zh: 你们要切切地求那更大的恩赐。我现今把最妙的道指示你们。
verses.en: But you should be eager for the greater gifts.And now I will show you a way that is beyond comparison.[NOTE:1]
notes: Grk “a still more excellent way.” In this context the phrase has an elative rather than a comparative sense, however.
